notes: The installed VST3 was identified by exact vendor and class ID; Corr. Amount, Smooth and Formant Amount IDs were read from that binary.
Graillon exposes twelve Allow-note parameters rather than one canonical key and one canonical scale parameter, so key/scale translation needs a dedicated adapter.
The manual defines Smooth as pitch-transition speed, with the minimum producing hard tuning. A dedicated adapter must invert/normalize it before it can represent MeeWav Retune speed.
No Humanisation binding is asserted: Smooth, Inertia and Snap controls must be evaluated with real voice before choosing a canonical mapping.
Synthetic processing proves execution, not audible pitch-correction quality, microphone monitoring stability or Room publication.
The plugin may enter the verified local registry, but it must stay unavailable in the user selector until the adapter and audio-plane gates pass.
